newsitem.title: USA: Independent Media buying Thomson paper.
newsitem.headline: Independent Media buying Thomson paper.

text.p: Independent Media Group inc said Friday it agreed in principle to acquire The Daily Telegram and related publications in Adrian, Mich. from Thomson Newspapers, a unit of Thomson Corp.

The Daily Telegram is a 17,000-circulation newspaper that publishes seven days a week. It is one of 29 U.S. newpapers that Thomson earlier said it would sell as part of a restructuring of the organization into regional marketing and communication businesses.
Independent Media is an affiliate of Wicks Group of Cos Inc, a New York-based private investment firm.
